profile.headline: I work in the same city as Chick-fil-A HQ. They have sit down restaurant. Isn’t that cool?
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in IBM DB2, Sales, TSO, Mean Stack, and COBOL. Strong engineering professional with a Master of Science - MS focused in Computer Science from The University of Texas at Dallas.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Conducted QA test on product quality.
Designed and implemented shift left and shift right strategy.
Negotiated with stake holders about future improvements.
Languages used: Golang, C#, bash
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Microsoft Azure · OSI Model · Kubernetes · DevOps

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented test driven development for groovy shared library.
- Optimized Java pipelines to run in parallel, reduced time from 25+ hours to 1 hour.
- Optimized Jenkins pipeline to use all 6 CPU cores to build docker images, reducing time from 1 day to 2 hours.
- Designed and implemented caching solutions for multistage Jenkins pipelines.
- Debugged Sonar, Veracode, Azure DevOps, Helm 3, Kubernetes deployments.
- Investigated Snowflake timeout issues and figured out how to fix NTP time in distributed systems in Concourse build agent. 
- Triaged Docker builds and fixed distributed system issue for large files.
- Trained new employees on Jenkins, devops.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Advised clients on choosing big data tools – Zookeeper, Kafka, ActiveMQ, Spark, Hadoop
    • Presented best practices on coding culture, communication, Git, AWS, documentation
    • Researched gRPC, HTTP/2, information security standards
    • Presented pros and cons of database types: MySQL, Cassandra, BigTable, MongoDB 
    • Designed user focused UI/UX and developer friendly processes
    • Performed text sentimental analysis, implemented chat bot learning with nltk, used Goroutines
- Interviewed cadidates.
- Designed deployment orchestration for distributed systems.
- Debugged distributed systems: race condition, NTP error, stale cache.
- Designed DevOps system for easy recovery, debug and onboarding.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Improved EC2 start up time by using AMI instead of installing during run time, reducing start up time from 30 minutes to 10 minutes.
    • Fine-tuned bottlenecks with Datadog, defined mitigation and implemented solutions
    • Optimized software with concurrency, queue, asynchronous I/O, freed up 1 hour per pipeline	
    • Wrote and deployed application with with Jenkins, Concourse, Kubernetes, Helm, AWS, Azure, Docker, containers, Hashicorp Vault, similar to Google, Microsoft, AWS cloud orchestration.
    • Built cloud monitoring tool with with pandas, applied chaos engineering with Gremlin, ChaosBlade, Chaos Monkey like Netflix.
    • Spearheaded GitOps implementation – saved $50,000/month in developer time	
    • Scale applications and created tear down script to manage cost.
    • Designed modular Jenkins pipeline like for ease of access and automation.
    • Provisioned infrastructure with Terraform, Cloudformation   
   • Spearheaded scaling up/down, deploy, tear down during weekend to reduce cost – saved $40,000/month
    • Implement algorithms:BFS, DFS for json, yaml processing instead of hard-coding paths in JSON.
    • Reduced toil and incidents resolving communication bottlenecks between cross-functional teams
    • Interacted with C-level executives in financial planning, capacity planning and hiring decisions.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Planned, managed and implemented web-based logical file system feature based on hash. Integrated to UTD's full-stack website.

Worked with client on getting requirement/negotiation.
Scheduled manpower.

Bitbucket: https://bitbucket.org/CSMC/spring-2019-team-2/src/master/
Website: https://csmc.utdallas.edu/

Tools: 
- OS: Linux
- Version control: git
- Container: Docker
- Front-end: Bootstrap, JQuery, Twig
- Back-end: PHP Symfony, Doctrine ORM
- Database: MySQL

Prepared:
- Requirement documents
- Project plan, stakeholder communication plan
- Priority of features
- Work breakdown
